answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 84 identities means 84 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the hollow pair is tracked in the signal ledger, the cedar audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward requires answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 34%. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
